<thought>Using the first precursor SMILES as the target molecule, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break a “carboxylic esters” group and form an “aldehydes” group, which matches the DIBAL‑H reduction described. This should return the template that, when applied retrosynthetically, yields the listed precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehydes"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
